packet.title: Source code as XML: tree-sitter trees with highlights (design and implementation)

item.p: Order (owner): the book first, then the grammars' own tests, then the implementation.

Mechanism: tree-sitter grammars vendored with their highlights queries and tests (third_party/tree-sitter-grammars, ); one walk of a TSTreeCursor with an explicit stack () into tree builder events; the highlights query through ts_query_* with the text predicates evaluated by sxml; the step limit through the progress callbacks.
API: sxml:parse-code and sxml:code-languages in urn:sxml, an optional feature in every build (, , ); no new CLI command ().

Owns: src/source_code.c, src/source_code_internal.h, src/source_code_languages.c, src/function_library_source_code.c, tools/vendor-tree-sitter-grammar.sh, tools/generate-source-code-languages.py, tests/tree-sitter/, tests/source_code_test.c, docs/book/src/source-code.md.

Done when: the chapter's examples match; the grammars' corpus and highlight tests run with a baseline; the size growth reported. Done 2026-10-20 (): the chapter (18 examples match); seven grammars (JSON, JavaScript, Python, C, CSS, HTML, Go); tree-sitter/suite 630 of 639 (corpus 452 of 452, highlights 178 of 187: locals 7, injections 2); sxml.wasm +1,990,621 to 9,693,235 bytes, budgets raised.
